messages:
Maya (PMM): quick thought — picking topic grid tomorrow. want a session that shows cost/latency tradeoffs + a 10-min live demo. who can do the demo?
Jordan (Growth): i can run the live demo if we keep it to one short prompt and one failure-mode fallback.
Sofia (Producer): note: we need to lock speaker availability across timezones. suggest rehearsals: EU-friendly at 9am PT and an APAC-friendly at 5pm PT.
Ravi (AE): i can join as backup and do the customer-scenarios slide. can we get 2 sample prompts that reflect real prod traffic?
Maya (PMM): yes — need 1 low-latency prompt (short generation) and 1 long-context prompt (multistep). jordan, can you do the long one?
Jordan (Growth): long one is fine but will stream. audience might expect streaming. add a note in run-of-show.
Liam (Ops): greenroom checklist: mics, latency monitor in console, backup host machine, vpn creds. i'll bring a spare USB-C hub.
Sofia (Producer): run-of-show draft: 1) intro (3m) 2) roadmap/benchmarks (6m) 3) live demo (10m) 4) panel q&a (20m) 5) close + CTA (1m). keep demo handoff to 30s max.
Maya (PMM): CTA: sign up for early access to Dedicated. capture leads via hubspot form linked to webinar utm. jordan — can you confirm the embed and routing?
Jordan (Growth): yes — use /webinars/greenroom-labs?utm_source=slack. routing: registrant -> hs list "webinar_may" -> send to Salesforce owner if company size >500. i'll post the embed later.
Ravi (AE): on failure plan: if model overloaded, fallback to recorded snippet + live commentary. need a 2-min recorded clip ready and a script for the host.
Sofia (Producer): rehearsal schedule: 
- Tue 9am PT: tech check (presenter + ops)
- Wed 2pm PT: full run with slides + panel
- Thu 9am PT: dry run with audience sim (20 ppl)
Can everyone confirm slots?
Maya (PMM): confirmed for Tue & Wed.
Jordan (Growth): confirmed Wed & Thu (Tue morning conflict).
Ravi (AE): confirmed Tue + Wed.
Liam (Ops): i can do all 3, will bring latency graphs and logs.
Sofia (Producer): greenroom-bot: ping for reminders 24h and 1h before each rehearsal.
greenroom-bot: reminder scheduled — 24h and 1h before Tue/Wed/Thu rehearsals. :thumbsup:
Maya (PMM): slide checklist: 1) one benchmark slide (p50/p95 cost) 2) single slide for model variants + fallback 3) demo steps + expected outputs 4) CTA slide with link + QR. please keep <6 bullets per slide.
Jordan (Growth): demo script snippet: 
```
Step 1: set context prompt (20 tokens)
Step 2: call model variant A, stream
Step 3: simulate high load by toggling route to variant B
```
I'll paste full script in google doc.
Ravi (AE): i'll draft the 2-min recorded fallback and share by EOD.
Sofia (Producer): action items summarized: Maya — finalize topic + abstract; Jordan — embed + demo script; Ravi — fallback clip; Liam — ops checklist; me — run-of-show + invites. target publish date for invite: next Monday.
Maya (PMM): thanks team. one more: let's include one sentence in invite about live failovers to set expectations.
Jordan (Growth): +1 to transparency. i'll add: "we may demonstrate fallback behavior to show reliability in real conditions."
Sofia (Producer): all good. closing thread — will follow up with calendar invites and google doc links. :white_check_mark:
